description: Change the Actions panel: create an empty set, delete a set, an action or one of its steps, clear every set, reset to Default Actions, load an .atn file or one of Photoshop's bundled sets, or save a set as an .atn file (Actions panel menu)

action.description: delete: the action to delete (or whose step to delete) inside set

filePath.description: load or save: absolute path of an .atn file

operation.description: create_set (New Set), delete (Delete), clear_all (Clear All Actions), reset (Reset Actions: clear, then load Default Actions), load (Load Actions), save (Save Actions)

preset.description: load: a set bundled in Photoshop's Presets/Actions folder, e.g. "Frames", "Image Effects", "Production"

set.description: Set name: the new set for create_set, the set to delete, save, or that holds action

step.description: delete: the step number (1 = first) inside action

name: edit_actions
title: Edit Actions
